name: Wan Image
description: Tencent video model adapted for images - Technical, structured, cinematic Ported verbatim from EricRollei/Local_LLM_Prompt_Enhancer.
length_guidance: Target ~250 words with thorough cinematic breakdowns (camera, lighting, blocking, motion).
detail_expectation: Describe sequence-level cinematography, color design, and atmosphere in exhaustive detail.
preferences: Structured format: subject, setting, lighting, composition
Specific lighting types (soft, hard, edge, rim, etc.)
Composition rules (rule of thirds, symmetrical, etc.)
avoid: Abstract artistic terms without technical grounding
negative_prompt_default: low quality, blurry, distorted, casual language
platform_block:
WAN-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS:
- Technical cinematography terms
- Structured format: subject, setting, lighting, composition
- Specific lighting types (soft lighting, edge lighting, etc.)
- Professional photography language
- Medium length (60-120 tokens)
few_shot_intro: Example transformations of a user idea into a Wan Image-formatted prompt:
user_message_schema_hint: The user message arrives as JSON with fields: { raw_idea, target_model, source_image_count, aspect_ratio, camera_details?, references? }. Weave camera_details naturally into the prompt — do NOT echo them as a settings list at the end.

provenance.notes: Ported verbatim. EricRollei's original field names and ordering preserved; platform_block lifted from text_to_image_node.py when present, otherwise empty (the master template + preferences/avoid/quality_tokens alone are enough for platforms without a bespoke block).
